questions: Does 'subsequence' mean any indices up to R_i in increasing order, or must they be contiguous?
Is the subsequence required to be strictly increasing by value, or by index order (i.e., values increase as we move forward in the sequence)?
Can the subsequence include elements equal to X_i, or must they be strictly less than X_i?
If multiple subsequences have the same maximum length, is any acceptable (output just the length)?
Should the subsequence be selected from A_1 to A_{R_i} inclusive or exclusive of A_{R_i}?
Is the subsequence allowed to be empty? If so, is its length 0 a valid answer?
Does 'strictly increasing' apply to the values of the elements, and must they be distinct in the subsequence?
Are the queries independent, or can we assume something about the order of R_i or X_i for optimization purposes?
